note: DEVELOPMENT independent NER gold set. Written and labelled BEFORE the author had read or run ner.py, so the labels do not follow the extractor's own choices. It is deliberately broader than the extractor's scope (it also labels INCIDENT and DATE_REF, and more facility words). Used to inspect errors.
guidelines:
Annotation guidelines (fixed before ner.py was read or run). Annotate the exact span text.
ZONE: 'zone 4', 'area west', 'West zone', or a capitalised bare zone name (North, South, East, West, Central); the whole span.
DROUGHT_STAGE: 'stage 1|2|3' (or one/two/three).  PERCENTAGE: a number followed by percent / per cent / %.
VOLUME: a number followed by liters/litres/L/kL/m3/cubic meters.
DURATION: a number (digits, one..twelve, or a/an) followed by minutes/hours/days/weeks/months/years, including '7-day'.
DATE_REF: yesterday, today, tomorrow, tonight, last night, this morning/afternoon/evening/week, last week, weekday names.
FACILITY: water main, pumping/pump station, treatment plant/facility/works, reservoir, pipe/pipeline, hydrant, meter, valve, tanker, sensor, tap, dam - in their water-utility sense only.
INCIDENT: leak/leaks/leaking/leaked/leakage, burst, flood/flooding/flooded, contamination/contaminated, outage, no water/without water/water cut, shortage,
  low pressure/low water pressure, discoloration, brown|dirty|muddy|cloudy|rusty water, odor/odour, smell/smells.
NOT entities: 'main road', 'Main Street', lowercase compass words ('the west'), 'meters' as a distance, verbs/nouns in a non-utility sense ('tap dance', 'to meter the flow'), 'last month'.
